This role will be responsible for the Department of Energy Grant reporting & invoicing, monthly financial close, bookkeeping, GAAP accounting, ASC 606 compliance, reporting, and tax planning while ensuring our SaaS operations scale efficiently. Develop and monitor budgets, BVA, forecasts, and financial models aligned with business objectives. Oversee cash flow management, working capital, and expense optimization. Implement scalable financial processes to support SaaS revenue growth. Collaborate with other departments to align financial goals with business objectives. Government Grant Management Oversee financial administration and compliance for DOE funded projects. Coordinate with project managers to ensure grant milestones and deadlines are met. Prepare detailed reports for funders and external auditors. Team Leadership & Collaboration Report directly to the CFO Work closely with cross-functional teams to support business objectives. Build and maintain relationships with external partners (auditors, consultants, and grant administrators). Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (CPA and/or MBA preferred). Must have experience managing government grants and compliance reporting. 7+ years of experience in financial management, including SaaS business finance. Strong understanding of GAAP, SaaS revenue models, and financial metrics. Proficiency with financial software and ERP systems (QuickBooks Online). Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
